frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.excerpt: If you are new to Linux or Unix-like systems, you have probably heard of Bash and shell scripting. Bash is the most common shell for Linux and Unix systems, and it is used for managing files, running programs, and automating tasks. In this blog post, we will cover the basics of Bash and shell scripting.
frontmatter.subheading: A quick introduction to Bash and shell scripting
frontmatter.title: Basics of Shell Scripting
